description: A real report in English, scoped to the [bug, docs] taxonomy. The verdict names `bug` with 0.9 confidence, over the 0.75 floor. The warrant grants `label`, `comment` and `assign`, so the run applies the label, assigns its owner `ana`, and posts the triaged comment.
warrant:
version: 1
labels:
  - name: bug
    description: Something that used to work and does not.
    owner: '@ana'
  - name: docs
    description: The documentation is wrong or missing.
duties:
  triage: [label, comment, assign]
